## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Matrix Size](matrix/size.md) | Returns the row and column dimensions of a matrix. |
| [Reshape Matrix](matrix/reshape.md) | Changes the dimensions of a matrix while preserving its elements. |
| [Transpose Matrix](matrix/transpose.md) | Exchanges the rows and columns of a matrix. |
| [Get Matrix Diagonal](matrix/get_diagonal.md) | Extracts a diagonal from a matrix. |
| [Get Matrix Elements](matrix/get_elements.md) | Returns selected elements from a matrix. |
| [Get Matrix Subset](matrix/get_subset.md) | Extracts a rectangular subset from a matrix. |
| [Set Matrix Diagonal](matrix/set_diagonal.md) | Replaces a diagonal in a matrix. |
| [Set Matrix Elements](matrix/set_elements.md) | Replaces selected elements in a matrix. |
| [Build Matrix](matrix/build.md) | Builds a matrix from supplied values or matrices. |
| [Set Matrix Subset](matrix/set_subset.md) | Replaces a rectangular subset in a matrix. |
